$comment_schema: Cross-impl golden vectors for the Pages filter-primitive evaluation (#1908 slice 2, increment a). Shape: { rows[], scenarios[] }. Each row is a page; scenarios apply an AND-composed list of FilterPrimitive wire objects and assert the SET of matching page ids. Only the matching-id set is compared cross-impl (representation-stable). Asserted by BOTH src-tauri/.../pages_filter_primitive_conformance_tests.rs (real query path) and src/lib/tauri-mock/__tests__/filter-primitive-conformance.test.ts (mock metaRowMatchesFilter).
$comment_scope: Covers the PURE-over-row primitives evaluable without global mock state: Stub, HasNoInboundLinks, Priority, LastEdited(Range), plus AND-composition. LastEdited Rolling/OlderThan are intentionally excluded — they resolve against the wall clock ('now' / new Date()), so a golden fixture cannot pin them. Orphan (link seeding) and Tag/HasProperty (mock-state seeding) are separate #1908 increments. State and DueDate/Scheduled are OUT of scope here too: PagesProjection::allowed_keys (PAGES_ALLOWED_KEYS in agaric-store/src/filters/primitive.rs) does not include `state`/`due-date`/`scheduled`, so list_pages_with_metadata_inner rejects them with AppError::Validation before reaching the primitive matcher — confirmed empirically while fixing #3314 finding 1. Their exclude/is_null and Between-inclusivity semantics are pinned directly against PagesProjection::compile by the existing pages_state_exclude_keeps_null_outside_the_in_list / pages_due_date_matches_legacy_date_predicate_oracle Rust tests, and against metaRowMatchesFilter by mirrored TS unit tests in filter-primitive-conformance.test.ts.
$comment_exclude_is_null: #3314 finding 1 — the Priority scenarios below cover all four (exclude x is_null) combinations. The exclude=true,is_null=true combo is the #2019 tautology regression guard: a buggy OR-join of the NULL branch and the NOT-IN branch matches EVERY row (the mock's Priority arm had silently re-drifted back into that shape), so its expectedMatchingIds must be a STRICT subset that excludes both the listed values and the NULL-valued rows.
$comment_dates: lastModifiedAt and Range bounds are full RFC 3339 UTC (…Z), identically formatted, so the mock's lexical ISO compare equals the backend's epoch-ms compare. Row timestamps are kept clear of the bounds (no boundary-exact values) so both comparison methods agree unambiguously. A null lastModifiedAt seeds NO op_log row on the Rust side.

scenarios.name: Empty filter list — no constraint, every page passes
AND-composition — HasNoInboundLinks AND LastEdited Range February
Priority high — include, is_null=true (OR-joined with NULL priority)
Priority high — exclude, is_null=false (NULL-priority rows KEPT)
Priority high — exclude, is_null=true (NULL-priority rows ALSO excluded, #2019 tautology guard)
